sourceNotes: 新增独立护眼休息与定时提醒，可暂停专注并与轮间休息合并，提供仅保存在本机的专注与休息统计
新增休息声音试听与自定义音频，支持轻雨、溪流、风声和噪音，在休息时播放
新增“开始护眼休息”全局快捷键，可自行设置组合键，默认不绑定
简化专注操作与时长设置，优化迷你计时浮窗、多屏休息界面和菜单栏计时入口，并适配系统玻璃材质
增强应用卸载残留识别
修复 Claude Code 额度读取频繁弹出钥匙串授权的问题
修复开始护眼休息时应用崩溃的问题
修复修改专注设置打断当前计时，以及切换音频输出设备后休息声音中断的问题
修复空间分析取消后扫描仍继续的问题，并改善辅助工具异常退出后的风扇自动控制恢复
移除专注每日目标设置与进度展示，保留专注和休息活动统计

en: Add independent eye breaks and optional reminders that pause focus and merge with nearby between-round breaks, with focus and break statistics stored only on this Mac
Add break-sound previews and custom local audio, including light rain, stream, wind and noise for breaks
Add a customizable global shortcut to start an eye break, with no key assigned by default
Simplify focus controls and duration settings; improve the mini timer HUD, multi-display break screens and menu bar timer, with native glass where supported
Improve app-leftover detection; leave potentially shared data unselected and preserve shared folders, retry failed items and continue cleanup after the app itself is removed
Fix repeated Keychain permission prompts when reading Claude Code quotas
Fix a crash when starting an eye break
Keep the current timer running when focus settings change and restore break-sound playback after switching audio output devices
Fix space analysis continuing after cancellation and improve restoration of automatic fan control after the helper exits unexpectedly
Remove daily focus targets and their progress display while retaining focus and break activity statistics
